title: Parallel transport, geodesics, Lie derivatives and Killing vectors
summary: Transport laws and the covariant derivative on a curved manifold; parallel transport; Lie transport, the Lie derivative and Killing's equation; tensor densities and the Levi-Civita tensor; geodesics as parallel-transported tangents and as extremal proper time; conserved quantities from Killing vectors.

objectives.description: Objectives will be finalised when the unit is prepared; the source material is 8.962 Lectures 7–9 (Lecture Guide page 2), Tong Sections 1.1.1 and 1.2.6 and Chapter 2, and Carroll Chapters 2–3.

preparation.description: Read the Lecture Guide's synopses of Lectures 7 (transport and parallel transport), 8 (Lie transport, Killing vectors, tensor densities) and 9 (geodesics, conserved quantities) (PDF page 2).
Watch Lectures 7 (second half), 8 and 9 from the video gallery (transcripts on each lecture page).
Second account: Tong, General Relativity, Section 1.1 (1.1.1 The Geodesic Equation) and Section 1.2 (1.2.6 Geodesics in Spacetime), reference-only.
Second account for the manifold language: Tong, General Relativity, Chapter 2 Introducing Differential Geometry (reference-only).
Optional: Carroll, Chapters 2 Manifolds and 3 Curvature (covariant derivative, parallel transport, geodesics), reference-only.
